title: Playboy Magazine Lot of 4 - 1972, 1975 Book + Bonus Magazine
descriptionText:
Description

Lot of 4 vintage Playboy magazines and special editions spanning 1972–1991.

Includes:

* Playboy — November 1972
* Playboy — April 1975
* Playboy — May 1975
* Playboy’s Book of Lingerie — September/October 1991

Vintage pre-owned condition with age-related wear. The older 1970s issues show noticeable handling, edge/corner and cover wear consistent with their age. Please review the photos closely for the exact condition of each magazine.

All four magazines shown are included and sold together as one lot.
